name: Bow of Nylea — a static line beside a modal ability stays on
notes: Found by the subject probe's 'reaches nobody' verdict (2026-10-13). A permanent whose activated ability has bullets is parsed as modal; the static line outside the bullets was guessed into a mode by its words ('creature') and switched off with it. On a permanent, an effect read from a line that is no mode is left out of the modes.
